name: Dědice (Czechia)
description: Blue field with a white wedge from the upper hoist corner to the lower fly and a white heart in the upper fly.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 29 May 2007 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.

features.role: wedge from the upper hoist to the lower fly
